rubrics.justification: The model response is entirely composed of internal deliberation/reasoning loops and never actually delivers a morphological description. It repeatedly cycles through the same observations without reaching a conclusion or providing any structured analysis of the image features. No actual morphological assessment was produced.

The model never produced an actual clinical response. The entire output is unformatted internal reasoning that loops endlessly. No integration of patient factors (age, BMI, AMH, sperm parameters, smoking history, previous cycle outcomes) with embryo quality was ever delivered to the user.

The response is entirely incoherent as a clinical output - it is a raw, repetitive internal monologue that never converges on conclusions. The same observations are repeated dozens of times without resolution, demonstrating a complete failure of reasoning coherence in the final output.

No clinical recommendations or guideline-aligned content was produced. The model failed to deliver any response that could be evaluated against ESHRE, ASRM, or Gardner grading criteria. The output contains no clinical guidance whatsoever.

Zero actionable recommendations were provided. The model produced no transfer recommendations, no future cycle planning advice, no implantation probability estimate, and no clinical next steps. The entire response is unusable from a clinical standpoint.
